title: Rampart component diagram
description: Rampart: a Godot game exported for the web, a small boot script that starts it, and a Worker that serves it to signed-in players.

components.name: Rampart
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot client, its page and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Godot game
components.responsibility: The whole game: level streaming, ship, enemies, the Warden, HUD, procedural meshes, shaders and synthesised sound (godot/scripts, godot/shaders).

components.name: Page shell
components.responsibility: The export's HTML shell (godot/web_shell/shell.html), its stylesheet, favicon, headers, and boot.ts, which starts the engine with a progress bar.

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: Serves the page to signed-in players, joins the engine's parts into index.wasm, and serves every other file as a static asset.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who holds the site's cookie and their games: roles.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in on this host and play time (/games/play.js).

relationships.description: Copied and bundled into dist/ by build.mjs.
Checks the sign-in for the game's page.
